simple.meaning: רִבֵּעַ (ribbêaʻ) is a Hebrew word meaning “a descendant of the fourth generation, i.e. great great grandchild.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: רִבֵּעַ (H7256) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Exodus 20:5, with occurrences in Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רִבֵּעַ (H7256) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in רִבֵּעַ (H7256) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: רִבֵּעַ (ribbêaʻ) / H7256 is traced through Exodus 20:5, Exodus 34:7, Numbers 14:18, Deuteronomy 5:9 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: a descendant of the fourth generation, i.e. great great grandchild
definitions.full: H7256. ribbea [ רִבֵּעַ ] adjective pertaining to the fourth (in a series); — plural in phrase וְעַלרִֿבֵּעִים עַלֹשִֿׁלֵּשִׁים i.e. those belonging to the 3rd and 4th Generations, Exod 20:5 (E) = Deut 5:9 ; Exod 34:17 (J), Num 14:18 (JE), compare 1 above

occurrences.englishText: you shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, Yahweh your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me,

keeping loving kindness for thousands, forgiving iniquity and disobedience and sin; and who will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, and on the children’s children, on the third and on the fourth generation.”

‘Yahweh is slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, forgiving iniquity and disobedience; and he will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation.’
